times: Guests arrive and are seated; prelude
Couple stays upstairs, out of sight
Processional march: groom with parents, sponsors, entourage
Ceremony proper: nuptial Mass, vows and signing of the contract
Family and sponsor photos; cocktails start
Couple's break upstairs; guests guided to the reception
Couple greets guests at the reception entrance; pre-nup slideshow
Guests seated, free to roam the souvenir stations
Games: couple trivia, Guess the Tune or Lyrics, other guest games
Guests to the right side of the garden; couple up to the balcony
Private first dance on the balcony with fireworks
notes: Guests go from the ceremony past the pool to the cocktail area, then into the reception through entrance ② on the parking side.
From 6:00 PM guests are seated and free to visit the souvenir stations until the host's welcome at 6:25.
Keep the walkway from entrance ② clear between the audio guestbook (left foyer) and the 360 booth (right foyer).
The mobile bar has two setups: the cocktail area for cocktail hour, then beside the buffet for the reception.
Second-floor suppliers load in through entrance ③, up the outdoor stairs on the garden side.
Keep clear all night: the service archway (caterers and restrooms), the prep rooms on the second floor, and the middle of the stair landing for the grand entrance.
The kids corner is unattended: help set it up, then leave it.
